steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid.
Enable eRFX projects for the prepared RFQ flow.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bid-rejection configuration.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the bid's Settings menu is available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Verify the default event end duration remains 15 Mins.
Verify the default evaluation duration remains 15 Mins.
Verify the Delivery Date field is empty.
Verify the displayed product detail.
Verify the displayed product variant.
Verify the displayed quantity is the prepared RFQ quantity, 31.
Verify the displayed delivery location.
Verify the displayed unit is the prepared RFQ unit, KG.
Create the new order using the displayed RFQ details.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closes after submission.
Verify the required success message.
